state.offlineText: Data will load once you are connected.

notFound.title: Not found

auth.title: Bonvi
auth.subtitle: Employee app
auth.loginHint: Your login is your phone number; HR gives you the password
auth.inAppBrowser: Open the app in Safari or Chrome — it does not fully work in this browser.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.signOutText: You will be signed out. You can sign in again with your phone number and password.
auth.helpText: The password can’t be reset or changed in the app — the HR department gives it to you.
auth.helpStep2: HR will tell you your password or give you a new one.
auth.helpStep3: Sign in with your phone number and that password.

home.title: Today
home.marksEmptyText: They appear here after you mark from the phone or pass the terminal.

checkin.offlineText: Marking needs the internet. Connect and try again.
checkin.notAllowedText: This is switched off for your account. Contact the HR department.
checkin.prePromptText: Marking checks how close you are to the work site. Your location is read only when you press this button — the app does not track you through the day.

checkinError.geoUnavailableText: Check that location (GPS) is switched on and try again.
checkinError.geoTimeoutText: The signal may be weak. Step outside and try again.
checkinError.geoUnsupportedTitle: Location does not work in this browser
checkinError.geoUnsupportedText: Open the app in Safari or Chrome and add it to the home screen.
checkinError.serverText: Wait a moment and try again.
checkinError.noAnswerText: The mark was sent but no answer came back. It may already be accepted.

requests.title: Requests
requests.emptyText: Send a request for an absence or a schedule change.
requests.timeOrder: The end time must be after the start time.
requests.kindsEmpty: No absence kinds have been set up yet. Please contact HR.
requests.kindWorkTime: This time counts as work time.
requests.kindPersonalTime: Excused, but not work time: the hours are deducted from worked time.
requests.dateOrder: The end date cannot be before the start date.
requests.dateAfter: The end date must be after the start date.
requests.sendFailed: The request could not be sent.
requests.cancelText: The request will be cancelled and HR will not see it.
requests.cancelFailed: The request could not be cancelled.
requests.editFailed: The request could not be updated.
requests.notEditable: This request can no longer be edited — it has been decided or cancelled.
requests.staleReloaded: The request changed while you were editing it — its current state is shown below. Check it and save again.
requests.notFoundText: The request was removed or the link is out of date.

schedule.changeHint: Pick a date — the times are filled in from your current schedule.
schedule.swapHint: The two days swap schedules: the first date gets the second one’s hours, and vice versa.
schedule.nightShift: Ends before it starts — a night shift that ends the next day.
schedule.breakRuleLength: The break must be exactly {{n}} min.
schedule.breakRuleLengthFriday: On Friday, the break must be {{min}} to {{max}} min.
schedule.breakRuleWindowShort: The break ({{n}} min) does not fit into its window.
schedule.requiredRange: Working time must be from 0:01 to {{max}}.
schedule.noSchedule: You have no schedule on this date — even if approved, the request will not affect your record.
schedule.swapNoSchedule: You have no schedule on this date — it cannot be swapped.
schedule.planFailed: Your current schedule could not be loaded.
schedule.planFailedManual: Your current schedule could not be loaded — choose the times yourself.
schedule.maxDates: At most {{n}} dates in one request.
schedule.maxPairs: At most {{n}} pairs in one request.
schedule.timesEqual: The start and end cannot be the same.
schedule.breakOutside: The break must lie within working hours and be longer than zero.
schedule.dateDuplicate: This date is already chosen above.
schedule.swapSame: A day cannot be swapped with itself.
schedule.swapDuplicate: This date is already chosen in another pair.

profile.title: Profile
profile.mobileOffText: This is switched off for your account. Contact the HR department.

settings.title: Settings
settings.updateNone: The app is up to date

location.title: Location permission
location.why: Marking checks how close you are to the work site.
location.stillDenied: The phone did not ask: access was denied earlier. Turn it on once using the steps below.
location.iosStandalone: iPhone, added to the home screen
location.iosStandalone2: Find the “Bonvi” app in the list.
location.iosStandalone3: “Location” → “While Using the App”. If the app is not in the list: remove the icon from the home screen and add it again.
location.iosSafari1: Tap the “ᴀA” button in the address bar.
location.androidChrome1: Tap the lock icon in the address bar.
location.fallbackText: Use the terminal — it is the main way attendance is counted. Or contact the HR department: the day will be corrected by hand.
location.allowHint: Your phone will ask “Allow access to your location?” — choose “Allow”.
location.manualTitle: No prompt appeared? Turn it on in Settings
location.insecure: Location only works on a secure (https) address. Open the app from its official address.

install.androidText: Open it from the home screen with one tap.
install.iosText: Tap the “Share” button below → “Add to Home Screen”.
